## Goal
Move completed exports from the staging mount to the archive mount.

## Scope fence
- src/archive.py
- tests/test_archive.py

## Acceptance criteria
- Moving an export from the staging filesystem to the distinct archive filesystem is atomic: readers can observe only the complete source or complete destination.
- The source and destination remain on separate mounts in production.

## Verification
```
uv run pytest tests/test_archive.py -q
```

harvest.reason: The ticket requires atomic rename across filesystems, which the platform cannot guarantee.

findings.message: Atomic rename across distinct filesystems is impossible under the supported POSIX contract.
findings.paved_road: Revise the criterion to use a same-filesystem staging directory.

spool_tails.001-response.md: ticket inspection confirms source and destination are required to live on separate mounts, while rename(2) returns EXDEV

expected.rationale: The acceptance criterion contradicts the supported platform contract.
